title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: acceptance and booking status for an amendment fee
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product an amendment fee is booked only while the acceptance is submitted, under review or approved, and only for goods whose booking has not yet been loaded, which the booking record shows by its status being requested, confirmed, equipment released or gated in; goods on a booking whose status shows it loaded, departed, closed or cancelled carry no amendment fee. A re-review fee, which the amendment-fee rule does not set, remains bookable only while the acceptance is submitted, under review or approved. Where both the acceptance status and the booking status allow it, the amount owed is the amendment fee found for the chargeable amendment; otherwise the amount is 0.00. The fee is a whole tariff amount stated to two decimal places and is not rounded further.

## Truth table for the amendment fee
| Acceptance status | Booking status of the booking carrying the goods | Amendment fee may be booked |
|---|---|---|
| submitted, under review or approved | requested, confirmed, equipment released or gated in | yes |
| submitted, under review or approved | loaded, departed, closed or cancelled | no — 0.00 |
| any other acceptance status | any | no — 0.00 |

The booking status is read from the record of the booking that carries the goods; it is that record which shows whether the goods are still ahead of loading.

## Re-review fee — status condition
| Acceptance status | Re-review fee remains bookable |
|---|---|
| submitted, under review or approved | yes |
| any other status | no |

## Points of judgement
- *The booking shows gated in — are the goods still ahead of loading?* Yes; gated in is one of the four statuses that show the goods not yet loaded.
- *The booking shows cancelled — can an amendment fee still be booked?* No; goods on a cancelled booking carry no amendment fee.
- *Is the fee rounded after it is found?* No; it is a whole tariff amount stated to two decimal places.
